# Master services agreement

Counterparty: Northbridge Analytics, Inc.
Effective: 4 June 2021
Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

Northbridge: sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics". Billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc." A 2024 credit check also returned a Wyoming LLC, "Northbridge Analytics LLC". Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.

selection_rationale: CRM account crm:NBA-102, contract MSA-NBA-2021 term/status, and related billing activity.
known_missing_information: Commercial dependence threshold and revenue concentration policy not in sources.
Identity resolution between CRM account and billed legal name required for dependency judgment.
